title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. regarding the money left out by my dad to built a mosque when he expired 1372 views Q. My elder Brother has passed away last month leaving behind His Wife, a Six year old Son.Our mother was also dependent on him. Please advise what is the ruling on his Inheritance.Please give detailed answer. 4418 views Q. Inheritance 1699 views Q. I am Syed Ejaz Hussain from Chennai. I have a question regarding property division. I went through previous answers but was not satisfied, hence I am getting in touch with you. Question: Father had purchased a flat measuring 645 sq.ft and expired without assigning any nominee. As of now property is still in his name and not transferred to any name. We are three members in family left i.e Mother, Me and Sister. Would appreciate to know how this could be divided as per islamic law? 1543 views Q. My Brother-in-law had expired in 2003 survived by his mother, wife, a daughter, and two brothers (one elder and one younger ?? both married). Please advise the right division of his a) Property, b) Amount (blood money) arrange by the govt for the family. Please advise the division among the above mentioned family members in the light of Quran. May Allah take us to the right direction. 2533 views Q. I am the owner of a house, although the legal papers for the house are held in the name of a family member. As I am not married and have no children, I am intending to give this house to my nephew whom I have bought up since childhood although I will continue to reside in the house. Can you please advise me how I can give this house as a gift to my nephew Islamically. Would a written letter suffice or should I do something else i.e. leave the house one time and give the keys to my nephew then return back. Please advise me. 1703 views Q. (Parents properties are not using by all in present) Q-1 Is it must distribute properties urgently after parent?s inthikaal (death)? (If we have problem in brothers) Q-2 Is it must distribute properties urgently after parent?s inthikaal (death)? ( If we have no problem in brothers & sisters.) If answer to hold parents properties distribution please tell me how much years we can prolong. Q-3 our sisters are not wants properties but all brothers are ready to give. My Father in law passed away last year. May Allah reward him with a place in Jannathul firdose. Amin. Summ Amin. My deceased Father in law has two sons-one married and the other a bachelor and one daughter who is also married. I would like to know how the property that used to be owned by my deceased father in law need to be distributed. My mother in law is alive and she is taking the family pension. Also let me know whether the children have any rights in the deceased?s pension also. Also my deceased father in law has got some ancestral property from his father. Kindly let me know whether the grand children (two grand sons and a grand daughter) have got any right in this property. Please note that there is no WILL on any of the properties by my deceased Father in law. Your earliest reply would be highly appreciated. 1676 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 168774 Country: india Title: If I marry with a widow with child what will be rule of wirasat for that child after my death? Question: If I marry with a widow with child what will be rule of wirasat for that child after my death? Answer ID: 168774 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 646/563/M=06/1440) In the above mentioned case the child will not be your heir. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
